skills.description:
[中文] AI 影视工坊是面向 AI 漫剧、真人质感短片、MV、广告和预告片的影视前期制作助手。它把一句话概念、剧本、参考方向或粗略 brief 转化为可执行的影视制作包：创意简报、角色与场景连续性卡、剧本节拍、分镜表、工具适配提示词、转场与剪辑方案、声音设计单，以及 Markdown/CSV/JSON 交付物。内置四层人物系统（题材预设 + 美学库 + 表演系统 + 一致性六查）从根上解决"AI 模板脸"；参考素材锚点提取 + 题材视觉锚定库解决"提示词太简陋"和"生成作品不符合题材"两大常见痛点；剧情推演与镜头跳转系统让每个镜头和转场都有叙事理由。适用于 AI 影视策划、分镜拆解、镜头提示词、视频脚本优化、转场设计、剪辑方案、声音设计、角色一致性、台词系统、运动镜头、生图构图、故事板驱动工作流或完整 AI 视频前期流程。斜杠命令：/全流程 /分镜 /提示词 /转场 /剪辑 /声音 /风格 /角色卡 /台词 /生图 /质检 /故事板（每个命令的触发/输入/输出见 `references/slash_commands.md`）

[English] AI Cinema Studio is a production-planning skill for AI films, animated drama, live-action style shorts, MVs, ads, and multi-shot video prompts. It turns a concept, script, reference, or rough brief into a reliable film-production package: creative brief, character and scene continuity cards, screenplay beats, shot list, tool-adapted prompts, transition plan, editing rhythm, sound-design sheet, and Markdown/CSV/JSON deliverables. A four-layer character system (genre presets, aesthetic library, performance system, six-point consistency check) defeats the generic-AI-face problem. Reference-anchor extraction and genre visual anchors solve the two most common complaints: prompts that are too thin and outputs that miss the requested genre. The narrative-to-shot system gives every shot and transition a story reason. Use this skill for AI cinema planning, storyboard breakdown, shot prompts, video script polishing, transition design, editing plans, sound design, character consistency, scene-adapted dialogue, motion-shot prompts (chases / one-takes), image composition (character sheets / first frames), storyboard-driven three-step pipeline, or end-to-end AI video pre-production. It is not for a single casual image or one-shot image-to-video clip. Slash commands: /全流程 /分镜 /提示词 /转场 /剪辑 /声音 /风格 /角色卡 /台词 /生图 /质检 /故事板（each command's trigger / input / output: see `references/slash_commands.md`）
skills.description_zh:
中文：可执行 AI 影视制作包：分镜表、双语镜头提示词、转场/剪辑/声音方案、场景化台词系统、
运动镜头专项（追逐/一镜到底）、生图构图（定妆图/首帧）、开场叙事结构（16 种序幕手法）、
Save the Cat 15 节拍+短片秒数换算、Murch 剪辑六原则+库里肖夫效应、渲染风格锚点库
（3D 游戏/3D 动漫/2D 动漫，PBR/NPR 可执行术语）、故事板三步流水线（锚点图→故事板大图→
图生视频，一张图准整套分镜，省抽卡 30-50→5-8 次）、提示词防护质检，
一键导出 Markdown/CSV/JSON。
English：Executable AI film packages: storyboards, bilingual shot prompts, transition/editing/sound
plans, scene-adapted dialogue system, motion-shot guide (chases / one-takes), image
composition (character sheets / first frames), prologue structures (16 openings),
Save the Cat 15-beat short-film timing, Murch's Rule of Six + Kuleshov effect,
rendering-style anchor library (3D games / 3D anime / 2D anime, executable PBR/NPR
terms), three-step storyboard pipeline (anchors → storyboard → image-to-video, one
16:9 image locks the full shot sequence, cutting retries from 30-50 to 5-8), and
prompt guard / sanitizer — exported as Markdown/CSV/JSON.

skills.description: Upload an encrypted HTML prototype to a public GitHub Pages site so colleagues can view it via a shareable link with a project password, instead of sending HTML files back and forth. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "上传原型", "上传到服务器", "发给同事看", "上传 HTML", "推到原型站", "publish this prototype", "share this prototype with the team", or similar requests that involve making a freshly generated HTML prototype accessible via a link rather than as a downloadable file. Also trigger when the user has just finished iterating on a product prototype and indicates they want to share it (even casually, e.g. "好了发出去吧", "传上去吧", "让 XX 也看看", "发个链接"). Also trigger for setup-related requests like "配置原型上传", "帮我设置 prototype-uploader", or when the user provides GitHub credentials or project passwords. Each project has its own password; HTML is AES-256-GCM encrypted before upload, decrypted in the visitor's browser.
skills.description_zh:
我们团队有个特别典型的场景： 
产品经理用 AI 生成原型（HTML），然后把文件发给开发， 原型开始在文件和聊天记录里来回流转， 没有版本管理、没有统一入口。 

真正要看原型的时候， 往往还要翻一轮文件，甚至一不小心就打开了旧版本。

 —— 所以我做了一个很简单的服务于产品的Skill： 
👉 不再发 HTML，而是直接发一个链接。 

产品和 AI 聊完并设计之后，只需要说一句「上传原型」， 就会自动把 HTML 发布成一个可访问的页面。 

同事拿到的是： 一个固定链接（永远指向最新版本） 
1.所有历史版本自动保留
2.按项目归档，不再到处找文件 
3.如果有需要，还可以加一个访问口令（浏览器本地解密）。 

整个过程，本质上只是把一件事改了一下： 👉 从“发文件”，变成“发链接” 
但协作体验完全不一样了。

现在再看这个问题，其实挺明显的： 
👉 AI 在重构“生产”， 
👉 但我们还没有重构“协作”。
skills.name: prd_uploader
